semantic_records_preview.text: Registry Failure  Project Atlas failed because Registry B rejected records without provenance.
Adding document identifiers and checksums restored Registry B acceptance.
Worker Conflict  One report claims Worker C completed execution successfully.
The audit report states Worker C was not tested after routing was restored.
Both claims must remain visible until execution evidence exists.
Science Control  A controlled experiment requires stable inputs, measured outcomes, and a repeatable procedure.
Causation remains weak when the control condition is missing.
Science Replication  Independent replication strengthens confidence.
